youtube.title: What if you lived above a tunnel to the central bank?
youtube.description:
Fortaleza, Brazil, 2005: a fake-grass shop opens across your street. 🌱🚚 Under your house, an 80 m tunnel ends right under the Central Bank's vault. One weekend, 3.5 tons of cash disappear.
Dirt vans pass your house every day. What do you do? A) Call the police B) Mind your business C) Ask to see inside – Comment A, B or C 👇
Sources: MercoPress, BBC, Agência Brasil (Banco Central burglary at Fortaleza, Aug 2005)
